main_text.p: עָרַב Ch. Miscere, commiscere: Spondere, fidejubere: Advesperascere: Sic & Syr. ܥܪܒ Et sol non occidat, ad Ephes. 4.26. Deinde Syr. est Ventilare, cribrare, Fut. ܢܥܪܒ Ut cribret vos, Lucæ 22.31. Inde Ch. עָרְבְּלָא Cribrum. Pahel עָרֵב, & tertiâ radicali geminatâ עָרְבֵּב Commiscere, confundere, conturbare, perturbare. Sic in Ithpahel אִתְעָרְבַּב & אִתְעֲרֶב Miscéri, immisceri, commisceri: Spondere, fidejubere.
עֲרוֹב, עָרֵב, עָרֵב Ch. ܥܪܒܢ Syr. Sponsor, fidejussor. Plur. Syr. ܥܪܒܝܢ Sponsores, Act. 17.9.
עַרְבְּנוּתָא Ch. Idem, Exo. 22.24. & Genes. 39.1. in Jon.
עִירוֹב Ch. Mixtura, mixtio, commixtio. Plural. עֵירוּבִין Mixtiones, mixta, commixta, heterogenea.
עִירוּב, עָרוּב Ch. Laganum, placenta, Num. 6.15. in Jon. ubi tamen legitur per ך; sed in plurali legitur per ב, עִירוּבִין ibid. v.19. & עֲרוּבִין, Levit. 7.2. in Jon.
עֲרוּבָא, עָרוּב Chal. Colluvies, mixtura animalculorum noxiorum.
ܥܪܘܒܬܐ Syr. Vespera, Parasceve, vespera sabbathi.
עַרְבָא Ch. Trama, Subtegmen. Hebr. עֵרֶב.
עַרְבִין & עַרְבִין Ch. Salices, Hebr. עַרָבִים.
עָרְבָא, עוּרְבָא Ch. Corvus. Plur. עוּרְבִין.
